title: temperature, top_p, top_k: removed in API version 2026-10-21
summary: Removed in API version 2026-10-21. Returns a 400 error. Earlier API versions return it when set to a non-default value on Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview.

replacement.value: Omit and use prompting to guide model behavior.

migrationNotes.text: Returns a 400 error. Earlier API versions return it when set to a non-default value on Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview.

Earlier API versions return it when set to a non-default value on Claude 4.7 and later models and [Claude Mythos Preview](https://anthropic.com/glasswing). | Omit and use [prompting](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/claude-prompting-best-practices) to guide model behavior. |
